Trump and Republicans promised to lower costs on day one. That was a lie.

Trump’s tariffs, his Big Ugly Bill, and his reckless war against Iran are driving prices up everywhere — at the pump, at the grocery store, at the doctor’s office.

Gas prices just hit the biggest monthly spike in decades, jobs are down, and families are paying the price for their failed policies.

Americans have been put last since the day Trump took office. You deserve better.

House Oversight Democrats have been calling for a hearing for months.

Enough with the cover-up. Melania needs to speak with Chairman Comer about making this happen.

The survivors deserve justice.


Julia Manchester (@JuliaManch)

🚨MELANIA TRUMP: "I call on Congress to provide the women who have been victimized by Epstein with a public hearing specifically centered around the survivors."



— https://nitter.net/JuliaManch/status/2042311237434819056#m

If Pam Bondi thinks that she doesn't have to show up and testify before the House Oversight Committee about her cover-up of the Epstein files just because she got fired — she has another thing coming.

We subpoenaed Pam, regardless of her employment status. We expect to see her next week, or she can expect to be held in contempt of Congress. Time is up for these games. The survivors deserve justice, and the American people deserve answers.


CBS News (@CBSNews)

Former Attorney General Pam Bondi

We are watching a dangerous and unfit President drag this country toward catastrophe — and Republicans refuse to act.

Invoke the 25th Amendment. Do your fucking job.

Targeting civilians would, in fact, be a war crime.

This man is deranged, unstable, and unfit to lead. He thinks this is a game. Republicans need to find their backbone, rein him in, and end this reckless war before more innocent lives are lost and this escalates into something far worse.

Today is a reminder that the story doesn’t end where people think it does — and darkness doesn’t have the final say.

Pete Hegseth — the most unqualified Defense Secretary in modern history — blocked the promotion of two Black and two women Army officers.

Let’s stop playing. 
This isn’t a coincidence — it’s discrimination.

These are servicemembers who earned their rank, served with distinction, and put their lives on the line for this country — and they deserve better than this mess. 

I’m demanding answers.

No sitting president has ever attended oral arguments — but this one thinks the Constitution is optional and that the Court must bow down to him.


The Associated Press (@AP)

Trump has arrived at the Supreme Court to sit in on birthright citizenship arguments, the first such appearance by a president.

Follow live updates. apnews.com/live/supreme-cour…

The Republicans cannot govern. Full stop.

They have the House, the Senate, and the White House—and still choose chaos and loyalty to Trump over doing their jobs and delivering for the American people.

Video

Team Crockett would like to wish our boss the happiest of birthdays! 

We are proud to work for such a fearless & inspiring leader every single day.

Happy Birthday, Boss!🎈✨

Democrats said not another dime to ICE while the chaos and corruption continues — and we meant that.

Don’t fall for the bait. Republicans did not save the day by finally deciding to do their jobs. Trump could’ve signed the Executive Order to fund TSA on day one of this partial shutdown. Senate Republicans had over 11 opportunities to fund TSA — but instead they chose to bow down to Donald Trump for 41 days. 

Now it’s on House Republicans. Time to put your money where your mouth is.

It’s Equal Pay Day — and for the second year in a row, the gender pay gap is moving in the wrong direction.
 
In 2026, women are still making just 81 cents on the dollar for the same work. That’s unacceptable.
 
Same work. Same pay. It really is that simple.

Republicans could literally fund TSA, FEMA, and the Coast Guard right now.

But once again, they’re choosing Donald Trump over the American people.

Absolutely shameful.

So let me get this straight…

Donald Trump is pressuring Republicans to restrict mail-in voting for everybody else — while he’s sitting at home voting by mail himself?

He's literally urging Republicans to withhold TSA agent’s paychecks until they pass his voter suppression bill  — the so-called “SAVE America Act”.


NBC News (@NBCNews)

President Trump cast a mail ballot in an upcoming Florida special election, according to Palm Beach County records, as he publicly condemns the voting method as

It has been over 30 days since TSA workers have seen a paycheck because Donald Trump wants to play partisan games.  

Democrats have introduced SEVEN bills to fund TSA, but Donald Trump is throwing a tantrum, demanding that Republicans fight with Democrats until his voter suppression bill — the so-called SAVE America Act — is passed.  

At a time when groceries, gas, and housing continue to rise, families cannot afford to miss another paycheck. 

Now is the time for Republicans to finally find t

It is completely tasteless and unacceptable for the sitting President of the United States to celebrate anybody’s death — let alone someone who served this country. 

Donald Trump continues to show us time and time again that there are no limits to how low he is willing to go.

This is who is standing up for TX-30 every day. If only little Jasmine could see…

Baby girl had no idea what was ahead — but she knew she wasn’t backing down for anybody.

“They got money for wars, but can’t feed the poor.” — Tupac said it years ago… and here we are.

The Pentagon is now asking for an additional $200 BILLION for this war.

We always find the money for war.

But when it comes to housing, healthcare, or feeding people? Suddenly it’s crickets.
